notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The job may have been unpublished or the link is out of date.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.text: We already know about the error. Try reloading the page; if that doesn't help, go back to the homepage.

forbidden.title: This section is not for your role
forbidden.text: The employer dashboard is available to accounts with the “Hiring” role. If you are looking for a job, go to “My applications”.
